entities.name: Christian Heinrich Friedrich Peters
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christian Heinrich Friedrich Peters was a German–American astronomer and professor at Hamilton College, New York, and a pioneer in the study and visual discovery of asteroids. His name is often given as C. H. F. Peters.
